name: Wizard Cats Tank Battle
detailed_description:
Choose from seven classes and fight other Wizard Cats in Wizard Cats Tank Battle, a cross-platform multiplayer game!

Wizard Cats Tank Battle puts a fantasy RPG twist on the classic arena shooter genre, with mechanics inspired by MMORPGs, MOBAs, and ARPGs. The gameplay emphasizes teamwork and support while focusing on skill and precision.

As you play, you’ll earn Cat Coins, which you can use to customize your Wizard Cat’s fur patterns, body types, hats, wands, tanks, and meows.

Classes

Choose from 7 Wizard Cat classes designed for damage, tank, and support roles. Every class has unique class abilities, including a buff, debuff, and ultimate, as well as unique stats.

Pyro-Prancer - Fire DPS
Hydro-Dancer - Water Support
Furricane - Air Glass Cannon
Purrth-Quake - Earth Tank
Pawadin - Light Support
Necropouncer - Death Tank
Voidstalker - Void Disruptor

Winning is about choosing classes that synergize well within your team, so you can effectively counter your opponents! Players are free, and encouraged, to swap classes mid-game.

Buffs are applied when projectiles hit allies. Debuffs are applied when projectiles hit enemies.

Customize Your Wizard Cat

Customize your Wizard Cat with a variety of fur patterns, body types, hats, wands, tanks, and battle cries. Find your cat’s unique voice by choosing from a community-sourced collection of meows!

Your cat will meow loudly every time you defeat another player, taunting the defeated and announcing your kill to the rest of the arena.

Earn coins as you battle and unlock exciting tanks, hats, and wands!

Powerups

Collect powerups around the map, including special spells such as Exploding MIssiles and Bouncing Bolt. Collect special buffs such as Zoomies (speed boost), Nipped Up (shoot faster), Storm of Claws (increased melee damage), Reflection Bubble (missiles reflect off the player) and more!

Fun For All Gamers

Have you ever been in a situation where you're playing a game with friends and there’s that one person who is either too experienced or too novice to really enjoy it?

The combat system in Wizard Cats Tank Battle was designed to ensure it is fun for everyone!

Novice players will benefit from the simplicity of playing a support roll: the same missiles that damage your enemies buff your allies! So, if you want a less experienced friend to have fun, tell them to stand behind you and shoot you in the back!

Experienced Wizard Cats players can use their knowledge to guide their allies into picking the best classes for the situation.
